content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Principal Associate Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
IIT Bhilai Principal Associate Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Bhilai Principal Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Principal Associate.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Principal Associate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required is B.Tech/B.E. from a relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Principal Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary offered is Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue for the walk-in interview is ED2 Room-405A.

faq.question: Q9. What is the time of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Bhilai offer any age relaxation?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any specific provisions.
